title: Stuck CLI Command Causing 400 API Error with Tool Use Blocks
body:
**Bug Description**
When any cli call gets stuck i.e. it doesn't exit like when running mkdir or npm create etc where the cli might be waiting for a user input (not sure why it stuck at mkdir) and when I cancel the command - to manually run the command. I see 400 api error tool_use blocks must being with a matching number of toolresult block

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: iTerm.app
- Version: 0.2.29
- Feedback ID: 7fea6439-951b-4864-85c0-e6f114abb3bf
author: iamsolankiamit
